title: Add autonomy handoff toolchain validator
summary: The handoff path now has separate dirty report, bundle export, verifier, and restore planner commands. Add one read-only validator that exercises the whole toolchain together so blocked sessions can prove the handoff artifacts are internally consistent.
expectedFailureModes: Individual handoff tools pass alone but fail when piped together.
The validator misses digest tampering and accepts a corrupt bundle.
The validator writes files, stages changes, commits, or pushes while checking handoff artifacts.
nextAction: Add a validate-autonomy-handoff command that runs the dirty report, bundle export, verifier, restore planner, and expected tamper rejection without writing Git metadata.
